why: Haven Clinic is a former church in Dogtown turned free clinic, run by ripperdoc Anthony Anderson with his assistant Odell Blanco; in vanilla it is the backdrop of Gig: Dogtown Saints, where Nika Yankovich's Scavengers storm it. This proposal restores the venue as an ordinary working clinic: the street-story section that holds Anderson's office, the clinic's pre-state staff and patient crowd, Anderson at work, Odell and two patients at the annex, the intact/restored fixture and lighting variants that vanilla's own cleanup phase puts back, and the front entrance as the proximity anchor.

open_questions: sts_ep1_01_prestate_entrance_lock: the name and the phase that owns each value point opposite ways (openworld, while the gig is playable and V can walk in, sets 0; cleanup restores 1). I chose 0 so the entrance is usable. The tour must confirm the front door is not boarded/blocked; if 1 turns out to be the intact pre-story lock rather than a barricade, switch to 1.

All three chosen communities have posture unknown: no community-area node for them exists in any converted sector, so their workspots could not be read. Needs a tour check for clustering, floating or duplicated patients (pre_state_com and odel_com both place patients, and pre_state_com and the outside crowd share generic patient records).

Anderson is placed as the street-story character (#sts_ep1_01_anderson_com, record Character.sts_ep1_01_target), not as the ripperdoc vendor. If the clinic should sell cyberware, the vendors layer must activate #cz_monument_av_ripperdoc_anderson itself; the venue proposal cannot (the ref is reserved by venue_phases.json's dogtown_vendors note, which is a note, not a live activation).

The vendor decoration variants (anderson_vendor/odell_vendor = 1, default_sts_01 = 0) copy vanilla cleanup, but without the vendor-active facts the stalls may look like empty counters. If the tour shows closed/odd stalls, fall back to default_sts_01 = 1 with both vendor variants 0.

interrior_area_patinets = 0 and interior_area = 1 are taken from vanilla cleanup; their exact visual effect is not documented in any converted sector, so the tour should check that the patient waiting area still reads correctly.

Odell's annex (odel_com) is positioned as the temporary clinic across the road. In our timeline it may read as a permanent second clinic; if the owner prefers a single-site clinic, drop odel_com and accept that Odell is not present.

communities.why: The clinic's own staff and patients in its pre-story state: a medical assistant, two bed patients, canteen patients, a parent with a kid and a big lowlife man. Vanilla's cleanup phase turns exactly this community on to put the clinic back to normal after the gig, so it is the canonical 'working clinic' crowd.

Anthony Anderson, the clinic's ripperdoc and owner, at his post. Vanilla runs this single-entry community whole while the gig is live (phase a); it is the only spawner for his character record that another mod layer does not already claim.

Odell Blanco, the clinic's co-owner and assistant (the gig's contact), plus two of his patients at the annex across the road. Vanilla activates this community whole in the venue's openworld phase and later re-activates Odell alone in his vendor phases; whole activation keeps him on site rather than leaving the clinic without its second owner.

variant_toggles.why: Intact facade with a usable entrance. Vanilla's openworld phase (gig live) sets broken_windows 0 and the entrance lock 0, and its cleanup phase repairs the windows to 0 again; broken windows only belong to the raid. The lock is left at 0 (the state in which V can walk in) because the clinic is open for business in our timeline; see open_questions.
No combat set-dressing (tents, barricades, scavenger camp) in front of the clinic. Only the combat phase turns this on; vanilla's cleanup turns it back off.

Open-for-business interior dressing: both clinics' vendor stalls visible (Anderson's ripper chair/desk, Odell's counter), the default pre-vendor set hidden. This is exactly the state vanilla's cleanup phase restores after the gig so both clinics keep running.

Normal clinic lighting instead of the raid's broken/flickering set: the openworld phase drives Default_state 1 with Malfunction_state, while cleanup returns Default_state 0 and switches on the Anderson and Odell vendor lighting presets.
No quest loot (Gaspar's implants and the gig's containers). Combat turns the loot set on; cleanup turns it off.
Quest-only devices (Anderson's laptop chain, the implant clue, reflectors, speakers) off, while the interior area marker stays on. Vanilla's cleanup sets exactly this pair.
No quest VFX (smoke/fire set dressing from the raid). Cleanup turns it off.

The street-story prefab's patient interior area in its restored state. Vanilla turns it on only while the gig runs and sets it back to 0 in cleanup, which is the state we want for an ordinary clinic visit.

proximity_wait.why: The clinic's front double door on Montaña de Oro Avenue, the device the player reaches on the normal way in. It is a DoorControllerPS entity that vanilla drives (cleanup ForceOpen, combat ForcePower), so it is a device, not a workspot.
